headline: OpenAI buys Glass Imaging for over $300M, report says
summary: The AI giant reportedly acquires the smartphone camera tech startup founded by former Apple engineers.
details: OpenAI has reportedly acquired Glass Imaging, a startup specializing in AI-powered smartphone camera technology, for over $300 million, according to The Wall Street Journal.

Glass Imaging, founded in 2019, was co-founded by Ziv Attar and Tom Bishop, who previously led Apple's Portrait Mode development team. Their work focuses on using AI to enhance image quality directly at the moment of capture, overcoming physical camera limitations.

The company had previously raised approximately $30 million in funding. This acquisition aligns with rumors that OpenAI is exploring its own hardware ventures, including potential AI companion devices and smartphones.
This move follows OpenAI CEO Sam Altman's previous collaboration with Jony Ive, Apple's former design chief, on a device startup called io, which OpenAI acquired for $6.5 billion.
caption:
OpenAI reportedly buys smartphone camera maker Glass Imaging for over $300M.

OpenAI has reportedly acquired Glass Imaging, a startup specializing in AI-powered smartphone camera technology, for over $300 million, according to The Wall Street Journal.

Glass Imaging, founded in 2019, was co-founded by Ziv Attar and Tom Bishop, who previously led Apple's Portrait Mode development team. Their work focuses on using AI to enhance image quality directly at the moment of capture, overcoming physical camera limitations.

The company had previously raised approximately $30 million in funding. This acquisition aligns with rumors that OpenAI is exploring its own hardware ventures, including potential AI companion devices and smartphones.

This move follows OpenAI CEO Sam Altman's previous collaboration with Jony Ive, Apple's former design chief, on a device startup called io, which OpenAI acquired for $6.5 billion.
